items.summary: It's Stem Ripper, and its expansion module accomplice, "With Mixer." Patch it up quick, record individual stems, and perform stereo mixing with aux sends, panning, and even external USB MIDI control. And fit it all in 6HP + 8HP, with clever Eurorack modules from ALM/Busy Circuits. items.title: Well Travelled :: Talk Talk’s Final Live Performances 40 Years On
items.summary: With In Another World: The Four Seasons of Talk Talk , music writer Graeme Thomson charts one of the most mystical trajectories ever undertaken by a one-time pop band. Today marks the 40th anniversary of the band's final live performance in Spain. To commemorate, we're pleased to share an edited extract from In Another World.
